title: Book Three · Chapter 61: Not This Afternoon
story:
The following Friday, Kai stays beside his desk after the bell.

Ronan is putting his books away. Anna and Lin are waiting near the door with their bottles.

“Can you look at this?” Kai asks.

He turns a page toward Ronan. It is about a story from class. The question asks why one man refuses a gift. Kai needs two details from the story in his answer.

“I know the parts,” he says. “I marked them.”

There are two short lines in the margin. His answer below them has a beginning, then a lot of crossed-out words.

Ronan puts his bag down for a moment.

“Tell me.”

Kai starts to explain. He points to the first part, then the second. His spoken answer is much clearer than the page.

“He wants to keep his own shop,” Kai says. “The gift comes from the man who wants the building.”

Ronan turns the book toward the light.

“I can see it,” Kai says. “I just can't get the order right.”

“That first sentence,” Ronan says. “Use that.”

Kai reaches for his pencil.

He writes The gift at the start of a new line. Then he stops.

Ronan looks at the two words.

Kai rubs them out before Ronan speaks.

“I started with the other part again.”

“What did you start with when you told me?”

“The man.”

Kai writes those words instead. He leaves a little space after them.

For a moment, Ronan wants to say the next words too. Anna and Lin are still near the door. Lin moves her bottle from one hand to the other.

Ronan keeps his own hands beside the book.

Kai reads his two words aloud. He remembers his spoken answer. Only two words are on the paper.

He makes a small mark at the end of the line. Then he looks at Ronan again. The book is open between them, and he has not given the pencil away.

“Stay while I do it?”

Ronan looks toward the door. He promised Anna and Lin a run. They have been waiting for him.

“Not this afternoon. I can look on Monday at lunch. Ten minutes.”

Kai's face falls a little. Then he looks back at his marked lines.

“I'll try before then.”

“Bring your own first sentence.”

“Even a bad one?”

“Especially that one. We need something on the page.”

Kai laughs. He puts the book in his bag and stands.

At the door, Anna asks if they are coming tomorrow. She and Lin plan to run in the park before eleven.

“Food afterward?” Ronan asks.

“Water afterward,” Lin says.

“I can bring more than water.”

Kai lifts his head. “I can come for that part.”

They agree to meet near the park tree at eleven. Everyone will bring a small thing to share. Ronan can make potatoes before he leaves home.

Then Kai goes to meet his other friend. Ronan walks to the track with the girls.

Anna starts first. Lin follows. Ronan takes his own pace and lets the gap grow.

At the first turn, he can still hear the boys near the grass. For a moment, he thinks about Kai's unfinished answer.

Then he looks toward the next line. Monday is written in his notebook. This afternoon is already here.

He runs his two laps. At the bench, Anna is waiting with her bottle. Lin is walking the last part behind him.

“Potatoes?” Anna asks.

“Tomorrow. Not in the bottle.”

She laughs. Ronan takes a drink and sits down, warm and breathless beside her.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

refuse＝拒绝；detail＝细节；margin＝页边空白；especially＝尤其。

## 理解问题

1. Kai的问题主要是不知道故事内容，还是难以写成完整解释？
2. Ronan为什么没有留下来继续帮？他们约好的帮助时间是什么时候？

## 读句子

**Kai's face falls a little.**

拆开看：Kai's face / falls / a little.

Kai的表情／显得失望／有一点点。
